name: @extend-ai/cli-darwin-arm64

hlido_opinion.headline: Solid CLI tool for Extend AI on Darwin ARM64 — reliable but lacks extensive documentation.
hlido_opinion.body: The @extend-ai/cli-darwin-arm64 provides a functional command-line interface tailored for Darwin ARM64 systems, making it a dependable choice for developers in that environment. Its performance is consistent, and it integrates well with existing workflows. However, the documentation is somewhat lacking, which could hinder new users from fully leveraging its capabilities. While it serves its purpose effectively, the absence of comprehensive guides or examples may deter less experienced developers. Overall, it's a solid tool but would benefit from enhanced support materials.

tier_rationale: STEADY (73) due to reliable performance and integration, but not VITAL because of insufficient documentation that may limit user adoption. Improvement in user support could elevate its standing.
